scope: Staged round-trip credential edits and Python 3.8 x86/x64 portable runtime dependencies

paired.comparison: The unchanged actual Source provider performs each real file write/delete. Native renderer candidates compare resulting typed YAML content including exact integer values beyond 2^53, retained named fixture annotations, file absence, and edit error boundaries. Raw representative Source/Native files are retained; whitespace/quote/flow formatting is deliberately not asserted byte-identical.

verification.native: 17 parser/provider regressions and 4 editor/dependency tests passed (initial 20, then 4 focused editor tests after adding output admission)
verification.x86: Final actual CPython 3.8 x86 corpus matched the same Source 184 observations through owned dependency import paths
verification.packaging: Actual bundle_dependencies output imported the renderer and its copied clib extension under python -S, retained foreign integer text and annotations, and completed an edit
verification.scope_reason: Covers missing/empty/comment-only/versioned/flat/flow/block documents, null and alias write errors, ref and whole-record replacement/deletion, comment ownership, multiline values, integer formats, Source scalar version formatting, and independent dependency copying.

behavior: The renderer uses the pure Python round-trip parser after pinned document admission, retaining foreign entries and arbitrary-sized integer spelling without constructing application objects.
Deletion clears the first entry annotation, removes its own annotations and keeps the next entry and trailing annotations. Whole-record replacement removes old record-body annotations.
Flow-separator comments omitted by the round-trip parser are recovered from YAML token boundaries and attached to their containing collection before the edit.
Renderer output is admitted again before it can become a persistence candidate, and library failures never expose a secret-bearing source excerpt or exception context.
diagnostics: Initial comparison identified three comment ownership differences; expanded 184-case input exposed flow-comment omission, inline section and record-body ownership, and trailing comments at EOF.

An intermediate empty-map trailing-comment candidate was syntactically invalid. Its exact Source/Native files and failure diagnostics are retained; output admission is now an explicit pre-persistence guard.
Recovered flow comments require marks carrying line as well as column; synthetic comment marks now retain the original location.
limits: This is an editor boundary qualification, not the complete file-backed provider. The canonical production provider remains unchanged until atomic persistence, serialized operations, watch reloads and disposal drain are integrated.
Compared file content and annotations do not imply byte-identical YAML serialization or complete general YAML formatting conformance.
Static PE/import and current-host x86/x64 checks do not establish Win7 runtime, complete Portable/browser or release acceptance.

cleanup.retained: Commands/logs, necessary raw failures and representative successful Source/Native files, parser results and XML, official wheel identities and PE observations. Required installed x64 runtime libraries remain; x86 shared interpreter was not modified. Shared Source/toolchains retained for C9.
